title: ACA s. 21 — Commencement of arbitral proceedings

content.overview: Section 21 fixes commencement of arbitral proceedings for purposes of the Act by reference to receipt of the request for the dispute to be referred to arbitration by the respondent.
content.glance: Section 21 fixes commencement of arbitral proceedings for purposes of the Act by reference to receipt of the request for the dispute to be referred to arbitration by the respondent.
content.study:
Module 1: Trigger
The statutory commencement trigger is receipt by the respondent of the request to refer the dispute to arbitration.

Module 2: Importance
The commencement date can affect procedural sequencing and legal questions tied to the pendency of arbitration.

Module 3: Proof
The party relying on commencement should preserve reliable evidence of receipt of the request and its contents.

examples.title: Rule fails or changes
examples.body: A party treats an internal decision to commence arbitration as sufficient without establishing the statutory receipt trigger.
